records.text: It is alleged that Rob Skiba was murdered because his research was getting too close to the elites' ultimate project.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, this man, it is alleged, was actually murdered for some of the research and the pieces that he were putting together because he was perhaps getting too close to the ultimate project of the elites.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Current searches found only family-level allegations about Rob Skiba death and no authenticated evidence tying his death to Gilgamesh, occult, or elite-project research. The alleged motive cannot be verified.

records.text: The Mount Hermon location is 33.33 degrees north and 33.33 degrees east from the Paris prime meridian.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: he was able to figure out that that location is 33.33 degrees north by 33.33 degrees east from the Paris prime meridian.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Official Survey of Israel coordinates place the Mount Hermon station at about 33.306° N, 35.784° E. Relative to the official Paris meridian at 2.337° E, longitude is about 33.447° E, not 33.33°; the exact numerological claim is false.

sources.title: Survey of Israel — Magnetic Stations Coordinates
sources.relevance: Provides official coordinates for the Mount Hermon station.

sources.title: IGN France — Difference Between Greenwich and Paris Meridians
sources.relevance: Provides the official offset of the Paris meridian used to test the longitude claim.

records.text: The Paris prime meridian is referred to in the occult as the devil's line.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: To the Paris Prime Meridian, we go by Greenwich today, but originally it was the Paris was kind of the standard for a long time there. And that is in the occult is referred to as the devil's line.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Official geodetic material documents the Paris meridian, but searches of authoritative historical and observatory sources found no credible basis for an established occult name devil line. The label is unsupported and not independently verifiable.

records.text: CERN's stated objective was to recreate the Big Bang.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Look up CERN. Uh it's a very interesting facility. Just look at this thing. The thing's huge. It's a the Hadron Super Super Collider they're trying to their stated objective is to recreate the Big Bang

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. CERN officially says the LHC recreates conditions similar to those just after the Big Bang. That supports the substance, but not the literal wording that CERN attempts to recreate the Big Bang itself.

records.text: CERN placed a statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside its entrance.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Well, it's interesting that all these scientists and people working over there on CERN decide to put the religious statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside the front door.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. CERN official material confirms that India gifted CERN a two-metre Shiva Nataraja statue and that it was unveiled on CERN grounds. The statement is accurate in substance.

sources.relevance: Official CERN record confirms India gifted and unveiled the Shiva Nataraja statue.

records.text: Gilgamesh's body was found in the Iraqi desert in 2003.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: 2003, the body of Gilgamesh was found in the desert of Iraq.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. The 2003 Uruk story concerned magnetometer-detected structures that an archaeologist cautiously said might resemble the epic description; no Gilgamesh body was found or excavated. Later viral body and mummy claims have been specifically debunked.

sources.title: Fact Check: Video Does NOT Show Treasures Looted From Tomb Of Gilgamesh
sources.relevance: Explains no Gilgamesh body was found in the 2003 Uruk survey.

conveyance.original_source: Rob Skiba Babylon Rising presentation clip

records.text: The U.S. military occupation phase of Iraq began one month after Gilgamesh's body was found.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Interesting that the U.S. military started its military occupation phase of Iraq one month later.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. No Gilgamesh body was found in 2003; reporting described only possible subsurface structures. U.S. invasion and occupation activity began before and during that archaeological reporting, so the claimed one-month-after-body chronology is false.

sources.title: Fact Check: Video Does NOT Show Treasures Looted From Tomb Of Gilgamesh
sources.relevance: Refutes the premise that a Gilgamesh body was found before the alleged occupation chronology.

sources.title: Learning from Our Military History: The United States Army, Operation Iraqi Freedom, and the Potential for Operational Art and Thinking
sources.relevance: Provides the official March-May 2003 invasion and occupation chronology.

records.text: The United States established 500 military bases and the world's largest embassy in Babylon after invading Iraq under false pretenses.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: We all know we went into Iraq under false pretenses, right? They told us weapons of mass destruction, right? They said that we didn't find weapons of mass destruction, but I have a feeling we found the weapon of mass destruction and we set up shop there immediately after that and established 500 military bases in the largest embassy of any other embassy on the entire planet in Babylon.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Government records support that the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad was described as the world largest, but it is in Baghdad rather than ancient Babylon. GAO counted 311 U.S. installations in May 2008 and 283 in November 2008, not 500; false pretenses is an evaluative characterization.

sources.title: Operation Iraqi Freedom: DOD Assessment of Iraqi Security Forces Units — GAO
sources.relevance: Reports 311 U.S. installations in May 2008, contradicting the 500-base figure.

sources.title: U.S. Senate Hearing on Embassy Security and Operations in Iraq
sources.relevance: Government hearing record describes the Baghdad embassy as the largest in the world.
